package streamdeadline

import (
    "errors"
    "testing"
    "time"
    "unsafe"
)

func TestMixedMonotonicDeadlineRefusal(t *testing.T) {
    mono := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
    wall := mono.Round(0)
    if !mono.Equal(wall) || mono == wall { t.Fatal("pinned time monotonic premise") }
    for _, read := range []bool{true, false} {
        for _, reverse := range []bool{false, true} {
            original, replacement := mono, wall
            if reverse { original, replacement = wall, mono }
            c := &lsfStreamConn{readDeadline: original, writeDeadline: original,
                readBusy: read, writeBusy: !read}
            err := c.setDeadline(replacement, read, !read)
            if !errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
                t.Fatalf("mixed-clock-basis-accepted: read=%v reverse=%v err=%v", read, reverse, err)
            }
            if c.readDeadline != original || c.writeDeadline != original {
                t.Fatal("refused rearm changed a deadline")
            }
        }
    }
}

func TestSameBasisAndZeroDeadlineRemainAllowed(t *testing.T) {
    mono := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
    wall := mono.Round(0)
    zero := time.Time{}
    zone := time.FixedZone("zero-offset", 0)
    pairs := [][2]time.Time{{mono, mono}, {wall, wall.In(zone)}, {zero, zero.In(zone)}}
    for _, pair := range pairs {
        if !pair[0].Equal(pair[1]) { t.Fatal("equivalent time premise") }
        for _, read := range []bool{true, false} {
            c := &lsfStreamConn{readDeadline: pair[0], writeDeadline: pair[0],
                readBusy: read, writeBusy: !read}
            if err := c.setDeadline(pair[1], read, !read); err != nil {
                t.Fatalf("same effective deadline refused: %v", err)
            }
        }
    }
}

func TestBothDirectionsClosedAndIdleRemainUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
    mono := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
    later := mono.Add(time.Second)
    c := &lsfStreamConn{readDeadline: mono, writeDeadline: later, readBusy: true, writeBusy: true}
    if err := c.setDeadline(mono, true, true); !errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
        t.Fatal("two-direction change must be refused")
    }
    if c.readDeadline != mono || c.writeDeadline != later { t.Fatal("partial setter update") }
    c = &lsfStreamConn{readDeadline: mono, readBusy: true, closing: true}
    if err := c.setDeadline(mono, true, false); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) {
        t.Fatal("closed precedence changed")
    }
    c = &lsfStreamConn{readDeadline: mono}
    wall := mono.Round(0)
    if err := c.setDeadline(wall, true, false); err != nil || c.readDeadline != wall {
        t.Fatal("idle deadline update must be accepted")
    }
}

// Test-only representation adjustment models a wall-clock step without
// changing the actual machine clock. The two deadlines remain real Go Times.
func TestSyntheticWallStepSeparatesEqualDeadlineBases(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now()
    if now == now.Round(0) { t.Fatal("pinned Go clock has no monotonic reading") }
    deadline := now.Add(5 * time.Second)
    wall := deadline.Round(0)
    if !deadline.Equal(wall) { t.Fatal("equal wall instant required") }
    sample := now.Add(2 * time.Second)
    type representation struct { wall uint64; ext int64; loc *time.Location }
    if unsafe.Sizeof(time.Time{}) != unsafe.Sizeof(representation{}) { t.Fatal("pinned time layout changed") }
    (*representation)(unsafe.Pointer(&sample)).ext = (*representation)(unsafe.Pointer(&now)).ext
    if got := deadline.Sub(sample); got != 5 * time.Second { t.Fatalf("monotonic duration %v", got) }
    if got := wall.Sub(sample); got != 3 * time.Second { t.Fatalf("wall duration %v", got) }
}
